verdict.rationale: Segment's Public API reference lists an Authentication section covering 'Scope', 'Permissions and security', and 'Create an API token', so the product documents its own scoped API tokens. Beyond those section headings, the evidence gives no detail on how fine-grained the scopes or roles are. missing for 10: documented granular per-resource/role scoping details, least-privilege token configuration specifics, agent-specific credential guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration
